question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "adapted."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Adapted" means able to exist in a particular environment because of changes that have happened to it over time. (समय के साथ उसमें हुए परिवर्तनों के कारण किसी विशेष वातावरण में मौजूद रहने में सक्षम होना)

 
 
• Example: *He drives a specially **adapted**__ car.*
 
 
 
• The sentence conveys that due to their widespread distribution throughout all climatic zones, birds have evolved their sizes, shapes, and wings to best suit the demands of their natural habitats.
 
• The correct answer is option 4.
 
• Correct passage:

There are over 9000 species of birds on this planet __out__ of which over 1360 are found in India alone. 81 species of birds __are__ endemic to India. Because birds are found everywhere, and in all __climatic__ zones, their sizes, shapes and wings are __**adapted**__ according to the needs of their habitat. For instance, eagles and hawks have massive soaring wings with primary feather that ______ (5) ______ out and allow them to soar high in the sky.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Changed: **to become different or to make somebody/something different. (बदलना, परिवर्तन करना)
 
• **Adopted: **legally take (another's child) and bring it up as one's own. (अंगीकृत, अपनाया हुआ; गोद लिया हुआ)
 
• **Converted: **having changed in form or character, or been made suitable for a different use. (रूप या चरित्र में परिवर्तन किया गया हो, या किसी भिन्न उपयोग के लिए उपयुक्त बनाया गया हो)
